file.string: Phone volume buttons control the TV
Open the keyboard when the TV asks for text
Keep the screen on while the remote is open

UniRemote has no accounts, ads, analytics or crash reporting. It connects only to TVs on your local network, using the same encrypted, paired connection as Google\'s own remote. It also keeps your phone\'s model and Android version from the TV, which can include them in its own usage reports to Google.
Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. Icons: Material Symbols by Google, Apache License 2.0.

Apps on the remote, their order and look
What each button does, and where it works
Channel +, Menu and Channel − on the right
Off: Search, Menu and Apps on the right, as for a streaming box
Not found. Shortcuts open apps through UniRemote Receiver, or an app\'s own link.

As the TV reported it on connecting. It stays on this phone.
As the TV reported it when UniRemote last connected, %1$s. It stays on this phone.
What each button does, from the top of the screen down. TVs differ, so some keys work only on some TVs, as noted.
Opens the TV menu: switch to another TV or add one, and this TV\'s Find my remote, Channel buttons and About this TV.
Sends photos, videos and other files to the TV.
Needs UniRemote Receiver on the TV. UniRemote opens it there by itself.
Turns the TV\'s screen on or off. The button turns solid while the screen is off.
Turning the TV on works only if it stays on the network while off. Many TVs have a setting for this.
UniRemote\'s settings: controls, shortcuts, this guide and your TVs.
Pairs another TV. Also in Settings.
Makes the TV\'s own remote beep, so you can find it.
Only on TVs whose remote can beep. The menu offers it only then.
On, for a TV: Channel +, Menu and Channel − on the right. Off, for a streaming box: Search, Menu and Apps.
UniRemote sets it from the model the TV reports. Change it here if it guessed wrong.
What this TV reports about itself: model, Android version, remote service and the features it offers.
Everything at once: a smaller D-pad, a swipe strip, and a row of extra keys.
The arrows move around the TV\'s screen and the centre selects. Hold the centre for an item\'s options, or an arrow to scroll fast.
Swipe to move, tap to select, hold for options. Choose Full, D-pad or Touchpad above the pad.
In Full, under the D-pad: swipe to move a step at a time, or quickly to go further. Tap for OK, hold for options.
Turns the volume up. Hold to keep going.
Turns the volume down. Hold to keep going.
Also reaches a sound system connected over HDMI-CEC. Your phone\'s volume buttons do the same while the remote is open.
Right: channels, or Search and Apps

TVs get Channel +, Menu and Channel −. Streaming boxes, such as the NVIDIA Shield, a Chromecast or the Google TV Streamer, get Search, Menu and Apps. UniRemote tells them apart by the model the TV reports; Channel buttons in the TV menu changes it.

Adds an app: one you hid, one from the TV\'s list, a popular one, or any app by its package name.
Once a day, when the remote opens. Connects to github.com; nothing installs without your confirmation.
